caption: The drawing depicts a stone mortar and pestle placed against a neutral, light beige background. The mortar is large, roughly circular, and appears textured and irregular, mostly colored in shades of off-white and light gray with subtle brownish shadows that suggest its rough, stone-like quality. Three distinct projections or handles are equally spaced around the rim. Resting inside the mortar is a pestle, whose lower half is of the same off-white color and material as the mortar, while the upper handle portion is brown, resembling wood, and tapers smoothly to a rounded end. The composition focuses solely on the mortar and pestle, centered in the frame, with no other objects present. There is a faint signature or inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Mortar and Pestle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
